title: RateGain Reboot
overview: The hospitality industry is evolving rapidly, but many businesses struggle with fragmented data and slow decision-making. Reboot was created to bring clarity and modern thinking to this shift.
challenge: Disconnected systems and delayed insights made it difficult for hospitality brands to make timely, data-driven pricing and revenue decisions in a competitive market.
solution: Reboot introduced a unified, AI-driven approach that simplified complex data into actionable insights while positioning RateGain as a forward-thinking industry partner.
process: Defined a clear visual direction aligned with AI, data, and innovation
Developed a clean and modern identity to reflect clarity and forward-thinking
Ensured consistency across all touchpoints (event, digital, communication)
Focused on simplifying complex concepts into visually intuitive elements
Maintained a premium yet approachable design language
Created a cohesive experience that strengthened brand recall and engagement
outcome: Reboot strengthened RateGain's brand perception, improved client engagement, and created a more impactful and memorable experience, driving better conversations and decision-making.

title: Rev AI Studio Branding
overview: Rev AI Studio is a suite of car rental technology platforms designed to deliver data-driven insights and operational efficiency across the industry.
challenge: Each platform required a distinct identity while maintaining a cohesive brand ecosystem, along with an intuitive UI and seamless digital experience.
solution: Developed unique branding, logos, and color systems for each platform while ensuring a unified visual language, supported by user-friendly UI design and a consistent website experience.
process: Defined individual brand identities for each platform
Created distinctive logos and visual elements
Established a cohesive color and design system
Designed intuitive and scalable UI interfaces
Built a consistent and seamless website experience
outcome: The platforms achieved a strong, unified brand presence with clear differentiation, improving usability, enhancing user experience, and strengthening Rev AI Studio's positioning in the car rental tech space.

title: Future of Travel — Dubai
overview: Future of Travel – Dubai is a content-led initiative exploring upcoming travel trends, powered by Demand-AI insights and real-time data forecasting.
challenge: Communicate complex travel data and predictions in a simple, engaging format that resonates with a broad audience while maintaining thought leadership.
solution: Created a video-led storytelling approach that translated data insights into clear, relatable narratives, highlighting future travel trends in Dubai.
process: Simplified data insights into key visual narratives
Structured content for short-form video consumption
Focused on clarity, storytelling, and audience engagement
Maintained consistency with Future of Travel branding
Enhanced message through motion and visual hierarchy
outcome: Delivered an engaging and informative content piece that strengthened brand authority, increased audience engagement, and made future travel insights more accessible and impactful.

title: OPTIMA dataSURE
overview: OPTIMA dataSURE is an enhancement to RateGain’s rate intelligence platform, designed to improve data accuracy and reliability for the hospitality industry.
challenge: Ensuring high-quality, accurate, and consistent data across multiple sources while eliminating gaps and inconsistencies that impact decision-making.
solution: Introduced dataSURE, a machine learning-driven framework that identifies, learns, and corrects data issues in real time, significantly improving data accuracy and reliability.
process: Simplified complex data concepts into clear communication
Focused on trust, accuracy, and intelligence in design language
Created visuals to represent data validation and ML processes
Ensured consistency with existing OPTIMA product ecosystem
Designed for clarity across digital and marketing touchpoints
outcome: Achieved up to 99% data accuracy, strengthening user trust, improving decision-making, and reinforcing RateGain’s positioning as a reliable data intelligence partner.

title: Navigator Whitepaper
overview: Navigator Whitepaper by RateGain was designed to present complex travel and revenue data in a clear, structured, and approachable format.
challenge: Simplify dense data and information into a format that is easy to scan, understand, and engage with while maintaining a professional, enterprise-ready look.
solution: Created a clean and structured layout with strong hierarchy, balanced white space, and subtle brand elements to improve readability and highlight key insights.
process: Defined clear content hierarchy for better readability
Structured layouts to simplify complex data
Used white space to enhance focus and clarity
Applied consistent brand elements across pages
Maintained a clean and enterprise-ready visual style
outcome: Delivered a highly readable and visually engaging whitepaper that improved information clarity and strengthened RateGain’s data-driven brand positioning.

title: The State of Car Rental 2025
overview: The State of Car Rental 2025 is an annual report designed to deliver data-driven insights, trends, and opportunities within the car rental industry, helping businesses stay competitive in a rapidly evolving market.
challenge: Design a visual identity that clearly communicates data intelligence while staying simple, intuitive, and relevant to the car rental ecosystem.
solution: Created a clean and meaningful identity by combining a car silhouette with bar chart elements, visually representing the connection between mobility and analytics in a simple and professional way.
process: Defined concept combining car rental and data intelligence
Designed logomark integrating car shape with bar chart
Developed a simple and scalable logo system
Applied traffic-light inspired color palette for intuitive understanding
Extended identity across report, ads, and digital assets
outcome: Delivered a clear and memorable brand identity that effectively communicates data-driven insights while maintaining simplicity, scalability, and strong industry relevance.

title: Designing a Sky-Scale Brand Identity
role: Brand Identity, Visual System, Design Guidelines
overview: Designed a scalable and structured brand identity system for BotLab Dynamics, a leader in large-scale drone light shows across corporate, wedding, government, and event segments.
challenge: BotLab Dynamics had strong market presence but lacked a unified brand system. Visuals were inconsistent across platforms like social media, presentations, and videos, with no clear differentiation between event categories or standardized design guidelines.
solution: Developed a comprehensive brand system covering logo usage, color palette, typography, and layout principles. Introduced category-based visual differentiation using color cues and standardized key assets like ads, emailers, presentations, and video guidelines.
process: Audited existing brand touchpoints and inconsistencies
Defined core visual identity system (logo, color, typography)
Created category-based color coding for different event types
Standardized layouts across digital and marketing assets
Developed scalable brand guidelines for cross-team usage
outcome: Established a consistent and premium visual language across all platforms, improving brand recall and recognition. Enabled faster content creation, reduced inconsistencies, and strengthened BotLab Dynamics’ positioning as a global, high-quality drone light show brand.

title: WTM London 2024 — Booth Design
role: Event Branding, Booth Design, Spatial Experience
overview: Designed the exhibition booth for RateGain at WTM London 2024, one of the world’s most influential travel and tourism events, aimed at showcasing products and engaging global travel professionals.
challenge: Create a visually impactful and functional booth within a 6m x 6m space that attracts attention in a highly competitive exhibition environment while clearly communicating product offerings and enabling meaningful client interactions.
solution: Developed a clean and structured booth design with strong brand visibility, strategic layout planning, and clear messaging zones. Integrated digital displays, meeting areas, and interactive touchpoints to enhance engagement and storytelling.
process: Understood booth space constraints and visitor flow
Planned spatial layout for visibility and accessibility
Created branded wall graphics and messaging hierarchy
Designed interactive zones including display screens and QR touchpoints
Ensured consistency with RateGain brand across all elements
outcome: Delivered a high-impact booth experience that increased footfall, improved brand visibility, and facilitated meaningful conversations with global travel industry professionals.

title: State of Distribution Campaign Landing Page
overview: The State of Distribution is an annual flagship report by RateGain that presents insights on global hotel distribution, booking trends, and technology adoption. The objective of this UI was to transform a data-heavy industry report into a visually engaging, easy-to-consume digital experience for hospitality leaders and decision-makers.
challenge: Translate a complex, data-heavy report into a structured and intuitive digital experience while ensuring clarity, readability, and engagement for a B2B audience.
solution: Designed a modern, data-driven landing page focused on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling through data. The experience uses structured layouts, visual patterns, and interactive-style components to simplify insights and guide users seamlessly through the content while encouraging report downloads.
process: Defined content hierarchy based on report chapters and key insights
Structured sections like industry challenges, technology adoption, decision factors, and automation trends
Used card-based layouts and modular design for better scannability
Designed chart-driven visuals to simplify complex data points
Applied consistent color coding to highlight key insights and numbers
Introduced strong typography and spacing for readability
Integrated clear CTAs like 'Download Full Report' for conversion
Ensured responsive and seamless user experience across devices
outcome: Delivered a clean and engaging landing page experience that simplifies complex research into an accessible format. The design improved readability, increased engagement, and positioned RateGain as a thought leader through a modern and data-driven presentation style.

title: Rate Insights — Branding, UI/UX & Website
overview: Designed and developed the complete brand identity, UI/UX, and website for Rate Insights, a car rental intelligence platform that transforms complex market data into actionable insights.
challenge: Build a cohesive brand and digital experience from scratch for a data-driven SaaS product, ensuring clarity, usability, and differentiation in a competitive market while communicating complex insights effectively.
solution: Created a unified design system combining strong branding with a user-first digital experience. Developed a bold visual identity using vibrant magenta and designed an intuitive website that simplifies complex data through structured layouts, clear navigation, and engaging visuals.
process: Defined brand positioning and core product messaging
Designed logo reflecting clarity, progression, and agility
Developed a distinctive visual identity using vibrant magenta
Created user-centric website architecture and navigation
Designed UI layouts for clear presentation of insights and features
Built responsive and scalable website experience
Established brand guidelines for consistency across platforms
outcome: Delivered a cohesive brand and digital presence that clearly communicates product value, enhances user experience, and positions Rate Insights as a modern, intelligent, and forward-thinking platform in the car rental industry.

title: World on Holiday — Travel Intelligence Platform
overview: Designed the UI, visual language, and digital experience for World on Holiday, a global travel intelligence platform that transforms large-scale travel intent and booking data into accessible, data-driven travel insights for destinations, tourism boards, hospitality brands, and industry decision-makers.
challenge: Create a platform capable of presenting large volumes of travel data, seasonal trends, destination insights, and regional reports in a way that feels intuitive, engaging, and easy to navigate while maintaining credibility and a premium industry-focused experience.
solution: Developed a modern travel-data experience centered around clarity, exploration, and insight discovery. The platform combines structured content architecture, region-based navigation, interactive report sections, and a visually rich travel-focused design system that helps users quickly understand emerging travel patterns and market opportunities.
process: Defined platform architecture around regions, stories, reports, and travel trends
Created a travel-focused visual identity inspired by global movement and connectivity
Designed modular layouts for reports, destination insights, and seasonal trend analysis
Structured data-heavy content into scannable sections with strong hierarchy
Developed reusable UI components for reports, statistics, categories, and travel stories
Improved navigation flow for faster discovery of regional and market-specific insights
Applied responsive design principles for seamless experience across devices
Integrated lead-generation touchpoints through report subscriptions and downloads
outcome: Delivered a scalable and engaging travel intelligence platform that transforms complex travel behavior data into actionable insights. The experience strengthens RateGain’s positioning as a travel-data thought leader while improving content discoverability, user engagement, and report consumption.
